items.title: Why Is Local Orchestration So Painful for Distributed Apps?
items.summary:
Running a distributed application locally means starting multiple services, managing dependencies, mapping ports, loading configuration, and making sure everything connects in the right order. What should be a simple development loop can quickly become a maze of scripts and manual setup.

In this Short, Fiodar Sazanavets explains why local orchestration is such a common pain point—and how .NET Aspire can make running and debugging distributed applications easier.

Learn more in How to Ship Distributed Systems with Confidence:
https://hubs.la/Q04t8BbY0

items.title: Why Would Anyone Hire You Now?
items.summary: In episode 1019 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, @JonKrohnLearns talks with Priyanka Vergadia, better known to her quarter million strong developer community as the cloud girl, about how individuals and organizations can best position themselves for the decades to come. She advises finding one's unique value proposition (UVP) or USP by asking deep, introspective questions about what truly drives them and what unique value they bring. This differentiation is crucial, as traditional skills like coding are now increasingly performed by AI, making personal and business uniqueness paramount for future success.
